ipeds.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Fayetteville State University (fall 2024 admissions, test scores, enrollment, 2024-25 costs)

ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions and fall enrollment counts (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024): exact counts come from the NCES admissions file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal, and nonresident-alien undergraduates come from NCES IPEDS fall 2024 enrollment by race (same portal). No Common Data Set could be found on the university's institutional effectiveness pages, so international applicants and admits, GPA and admission factors are not included. SAT/ACT ranges cover enrolled first-time students who sent scores (SAT 2%, ACT 8%). Undergraduate enrollment is 6,074 and there are 90 nonresident-alien undergraduates (IPEDS fall 2024); College Navigator prints the student-to-faculty ratio as 20 to 1.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition includes required fees; total is the on-campus cost of attendance for North Carolina residents ($22,958 at the out-of-state rate). See the cycle file for the NC Promise rates starting fall 2027
